author: Elitheri
body:
I just went from Archdruid to Nekromancer and have been one-shotting most enemies since about lv160. Maybe take a look at your equipment, or add some buff spells to your lineup. I use Golem's Fortitude for particularly difficult things like bosses or gauntlets, and when I was an Archdruid I had most of my equipment upgraded to lv7, and it was all Ornate equipment that was T6 or T7. I also dual wield staffs instead of use an offhand

Also, can confirm that multistrikes and the multistriking elemental spells are good for enemies that only have around 1-2k hp with the setup I have. Once you have your gear beefed up enough to withstand taking some hits, the Sorrow spells should be easier to use (Sorrow 2 and 3 will be most useful in the Arena and against raid bosses), especially if you have a follower that buffs you/debuffs enemies.

Work on all of these and modify it to fit your needs as you play around with your build. Eventually you'll turn into a glass canon and can reap most anything that comes your way.

author: Elidanatto
body:
Mages take work to be decent. Some of the gear we get is meh till t8 or 9. Rn i think the staff you'd want is tiamat or arisen ahnk, though I think tiamat and typhoon are t8 (lvl 175) though. Zerk is also very high risk reward right now. Used to damage over time applied to only action turns, now they apply to every turn. So you can't super zerk (z1 n 2) without juggling hp more frequently. Id suggest when pushing to t9 (lvl 200) look for decent immortal gear, which gives lots of hp, and not 1 but 2 good staves. Sequencer, a dualweilding mage, is really powerful though it leaves you open to lower defense, which is why immortals acts as a sponge to soak up damage. You'll see balor king too at t8 I think, which his crown does get replaced real soon its still decent. Arisen witch's hat from arisen Carman is just a reskined balor crown with less jewel slots. 

Also summon dead 2 is great when you get it, and look for sorrow 3 as well bc beast den theme dungeons over charge it well. S3 is an amazing raiding spell. 

Now that 3.0 is rolling out also look for valley of drake theme dungeons, im not sure what teir the new mob is, called galistant or something, but it drops questing gear which gives more orns and slight boost in xp. Really good for the farm, as the only other orns and xp wepons i think are outside the mage line.

Happy farming.

author: doppeldrache
body:
similar to others... i was archdruid/nekro and just turned omni.    

i stuck with berserk the whole way to T9.   I smoked pretty much everything in my path.  Didn't bother with berserkII though.  found i was just too squishy for it.

magic strikes II is your best dmg for the mana cost. (and your elemental multi) sorrow2 is great for pvp and world bosses. 

use sorrow 3 for raiding (but only if you can kill enough beasts to keep it charged up.  so happy to drop that now that i'm omni!)

equip an arch-gadget (even a cr4p one) and use jinns.  use wyverns. use golems fort. use barrierII.   

I preferred to dual wield staffs. get two good ones and upgrade them to L10.   once you hit 175 you'll get a whole new set of ornate dokkalfar/nothren gear so level that up to 10 too. dont bother Masterforging anything.

run gauntlets in boss mode (once you survive it!) and you'll get more chances to pray to RNG for a good weapon drop (tiamat/hydra/cthulu) 

always have coins on.  gauntlets drop loads.

travel on the train/bus. bosses a plenty!

i lvled 185-200 pretty much purely at home with world raid bosses.  

have fun, mages kick @$$! :)
